results.answer: Sigrid Sture (also known as Sigrid Sture Banér) is the child of Peter Andreas Heiberg, as she is described as the niece of queen Margaret Leijonhufvud, who is the daughter of Peter Andreas Heiberg and Märta Erikdotter Leijonhufvud.
